docs.description: List-style row used in the Agenda view and as a denser alternative to Day Cell. Comfortable density shows start time, end time, title, and a metadata line; compact collapses to a single time range and title only. Category dot color is bound to data/category and should match the source event.

dot.background.reason: The dot is the event's colour, which "should match the source event", as the description says: the caller's (an Event Chip's category colour). Without one, it is Figma's, data/category/06/strong.
